limitations: All35 retained fresh public candidates were visually reviewed before any foreground prediction. References are AI-reviewed, not independently human-accepted; model pretraining membership and real-world representativeness remain unknown. Five mixed scenes contain genuinely different supported forms, including historical/museum collections; those are explicit domain limitations, not modern-packaging or true-material evidence. One provisional metadata-derived mixed-pantry label was transparently corrected to jar before freeze after two AI visual reviews and root engineering approval, with the original specification retained; no model outputs informed that correction. Four sources lacked attribution metadata: one original failed reserve response was not retained and is conservatively charged its entire1.5MB cap, never retried; three others were excluded before new fetches.35 retained candidates plus one failed fetch give36 image attempts, within40/25MB; byte accounting uses an explicit conservative upper bound, not invented exact failed-response bytes. Prior123 sources and known physical/source-series variants, including the Meanwell series, are excluded. Privacy observations are limited AI review, not a guarantee of all third-party rights. Images do not verify identity, composition, packaging, hazard, deposit or sorting truth.
